parameters.content:
## Request Notification
Convex POSTs a signed event here when a request is created or changes status.

1. Verify the HMAC over the raw bytes, with a timestamp check and constant-time compare.
2. Respond before doing the work, so Convex is not held open.
3. Claim, send, write back. Each write-back is signed and idempotent.

parameters.errorMessage: Rejected a webhook with an invalid or stale signature
